class_guess: Sync bouncer counter, spread-digit variant (binary counter whose digits sit inside the bouncer body)
summary: Bouncer carrying a binary counter whose digits sit in its body; each overflow inserts a new digit ~4x farther out
mechanism: Bouncer: the head shuttles from the left edge into the tape; each trip adds one (010) block to the left lead a.
The (100) body holds 7-cell digits 0b10001; each trip is a binary +1 (run to the first 0-digit, set it, clear the 1s).
Right end frozen. At overflow (all 1s) a long pause cuts a new lowest digit from the lead, ~4x farther out.

rules.name: Inc (one bounce = binary +1)
rules.to: same with a+1 and bits b0..bk + 1 (b0..b(j-1): 1->0, bj: 0->1)
rules.cases: j = lowest 0 bit; needs some bi = 0 (else Ovf). Holds for every a>=1, gi>=1, 1-6 digits

rules.name: Ovf-insert (overflow pause, long lead)
rules.cases: a >= g'+6, g' = 2044 - 2g1 - 4g2 - 8g3 (k=3; general 2^(2k+5)-4-sum 2^i g_i matches all 4 real inserts). R* = real R at step 114113163

rules.name: Ovf-short (overflow pause, short lead)
rules.to: 0^inf <A (010)^(a-1) [same digits and gaps, counter reloaded] R' 0^inf
rules.cases: a < g'+6: no insert, gaps unchanged; reloaded counter value rises by 2 per +1 in a (checked a = 100..115)

template.diff: mirror + relabel E<->F gives 1RB0LF_0RC---_1RD0RA_1LA0RC_0LA0LE_1LE1LB; only D0 differs: ours 1LE, template 1LA
template.note: Template LInc/RInc0, mirrored: 10/10 on the template, 0/10 on ours. Same idea (binary counter + unary sync), but our digits are spread through the unary body, not packed in a 4-cell-digit counter.

strategy: Family proof in the SBCv2 spirit but with new shapes: (1) Inc as an ind-lemma over a 'spread counter' (digits 0b10001 between (100)^g gaps; shift rules over (100)^g via es/sideRLs); (2) map the overflow pause into exact sub-rules (insert / short-lead / R growth), not yet done; (3) multistep_nonhalt + progress_nonhalt_cond with an invariant on (a, k, gaps, counter value), like SBCv2's P(k,n).
risks: Overflow pause internals are unmapped: R growth and multi-insert pauses (step 1.1e8 inserted 1028, 4097 and 7). They are most of the proof.
Size: nested counters plus an arithmetic invariant; expect 30-80 KB, well over the 15 KB target.
Only 4 real overflows exist in 1e10 steps (the next is far beyond reach), so the long-term rules rest on synthetic-config probes.
